source_allocation: Hamilton proportional allocation over B/G0.05/C/H1; C1+C2 pooled as C; ties use source-name order; zero allocations are retained in metadata
overall_estimator: test: S1/S2 source-label cells only; train: S6 label cells only; S3-S5 overlap those populations and are diagnostic

low_positive.tie_rule: include all scores <= the full-test positive quantile

offset_config.texture_reference: q20 of unshifted unchanged windows in first 40 real pairs
offset_config.interpolation: nearest valid grid center; Euclidean distance in pixels recorded
offset_config.piece_grid: area-weighted valid overlapping windows; nearest valid center only if none overlap
offset_config.primary_piece_reason: centered full-size window avoids distant grid interpolation for small/edge pieces
offset_config.direction: t2 displacement relative to t1: +dx right, +dy down
